items.name: Audi
items.warranty: 2 years, unlimited mileage (standard international coverage)
items.serviceNetwork: Single showroom in Kathmandu operated by Kaeros International; Audi only launched officially in Nepal in 2026 with its Q4 e-tron electric lineup.
items.overview: Audi is a German premium automaker, part of the Volkswagen Group, known for its 'Vorsprung durch Technik' engineering philosophy, quattro all-wheel drive heritage, and design-led sedans and SUVs. In recent years Audi has shifted its newest launches toward electric vehicles. Audi made its official entry into Nepal through Kaeros International, debuting with the Q4 e-tron electric SUV.

items.name: Avatr
items.nepalDealer: CG Motors (CG MAW Evolution Pvt. Ltd.)
items.warranty: 8 years / 160,000 km battery and motor; 5 years / 100,000 km vehicle warranty
items.serviceNetwork: Single showroom at Panipokhari, Kathmandu, operated by CG Motors.
items.overview: Avatr is a Chinese premium electric-vehicle joint venture between Changan Automobile, battery maker CATL, and Huawei, which supplies smart-cockpit and driver-assistance technology. The brand focuses on design-forward, tech-heavy luxury EVs, led by the Avatr 11 and Avatr 12 globally. In Nepal, Avatr entered via CG Motors with the Avatr 11 SUV, with the Avatr 07 expected to follow.

items.name: BAIC
items.fullName: Beijing Automotive Group Co., Ltd. (BAIC Group)
items.serviceNetwork: Single showroom at Naxal, Kathmandu (shared with sister brand Arcfox); BAIC only launched in Nepal in 2026 via Laxmi Group.
items.overview: BAIC Group (Beijing Automotive Group) is one of China's largest state-owned automakers, tracing its roots to 1958 and historically known for producing vehicles used in Chinese government fleets. Its portfolio spans SUVs, sedans, and new-energy vehicles across sub-brands including Arcfox. BAIC entered Nepal in 2026 through Laxmi Group, launching with the BJ30 hybrid SUV.
strengths: Backed by Laxmi Group in Nepal

items.name: BMW
items.warranty: 2 years, unlimited mileage (standard international coverage)
items.serviceNetwork: 10,165 sq ft showroom and service center at Tinkune, Kathmandu, operated by Laxmi Premium Motors (Laxmi Group).
items.overview: BMW (Bayerische Motoren Werke) is a German luxury automaker founded in 1916, globally recognized for its 'Sheer Driving Pleasure' philosophy and performance-oriented sedans, SUVs, and electric models. BMW cars are sold in Nepal exclusively through Laxmi Premium Motors, which operates a dedicated showroom and service facility in Tinkune, Kathmandu.

items.name: BYD
items.tagline: Empowering the future with clean energy
items.warranty: 6 years / 150,000 km battery warranty
items.serviceNetwork: 8 service centers, expanding
items.overview: BYD is the world's largest EV manufacturer and is rapidly gaining ground in Nepal. The Atto 3 offers 420 km real range and a class-exclusive rotating touchscreen at Nepal's most competitive EV price. BYD's in-house LFP blade battery technology provides best-in-class safety and longevity — backed by a 6-year warranty.

items.name: Changan
items.warranty: 8 years / 240,000 km battery, 8 years / 150,000 km motor (EV models; ICE models carry separate standard terms)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed by MAW Vriddhi Autocorp with showroom presence in Kathmandu; part of the broader MAW Vriddhi network that also handles Deepal and Dongfeng.
items.overview: Changan Automobile is one of China's largest automakers, with a corporate history dating to 1862 and modern passenger-vehicle manufacturing since the 1980s. It produces a wide range of gasoline, hybrid, and electric vehicles and is the parent company of EV sub-brand Deepal. In Nepal, Changan models including the Alsvin sedan, Lumin city EV, and newer Nevo Q05 are distributed by MAW Vriddhi Autocorp.
strengths: Wide range: ICE, hybrid and EV models
Backed by MAW Vriddhi's distribution network

items.name: Chery
items.warranty: 8 years / 180,000 km battery, 8 years / 160,000 km motor (standard); extendable to 11 years / 240,000 km battery and 11 years / 200,000 km motor via SPG Automobiles
items.serviceNetwork: Flagship showroom at Thapathali, Kathmandu, operated by SPG Automobiles, distributing the Omoda, Jaecoo, and iCAUR lines.
items.overview: Chery Automobile is a major Chinese manufacturer founded in 1997 that has ranked as China's top passenger-vehicle exporter for multiple consecutive years. Its Omoda and Jaecoo sub-brands target the global SUV and crossover market with ICE, hybrid, and electric options. Chery entered Nepal in 2024 through SPG Automobiles, which operates a flagship showroom in Thapathali, Kathmandu, and offers one of the longest extended EV warranties in the local market.

items.name: Deepal
items.warranty: 8 years / 240,000 km battery, 8 years / 150,000 km motor (standard); extendable to 11 years / 300,000 km battery and 11 years / 200,000 km motor via MAW Vriddhi
items.serviceNetwork: Showrooms in Naxal and Maharajgunj, Kathmandu, plus Pokhara via Himalaya Motors; distributed by MAW Vriddhi Autocorp.
items.overview: Deepal is an electric-vehicle brand under Changan Automobile, using CATL battery technology and positioned as a tech-forward SUV and sedan lineup including the S07, L07, E07, and S05. In Nepal, Deepal is distributed by MAW Vriddhi Autocorp, which has expanded from its original Naxal showroom to Maharajgunj (via Apollo Motors) and Pokhara (via Himalaya Motors). MAW Vriddhi also introduced what it markets as Nepal's longest extended EV warranty for Deepal models.
strengths: Nepal's longest extended EV warranty (11 yrs)

items.name: Dongfeng
items.warranty: 8 years / 150,000-200,000 km battery and motor (standard, varies by model); extendable to 11 years / 250,000 km via MAW Vriddhi (with Shikhar Insurance)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed by MAW Vriddhi with a dealer network including Bhattarai & Brothers Suppliers, Emrald Auto Mobiles, Narayani Auto Corp, Mahabir Automobiles, Euro Automotives, Silvermoon Motors, Carina Motors, and Brisha across Nepal.
items.overview: Dongfeng Motor Corporation is one of China's oldest and largest state-owned automakers, established in 1969. It entered Nepal's EV market in 2024 under its Nammi sub-brand, offering compact and crossover electric vehicles such as the Nammi 01/Box and Nammi Vigo. MAW Vriddhi is the authorized distributor, supported by a multi-dealer network across Nepal.
strengths: Nammi EV sub-brand built for value

items.name: Foday
items.overview: Foday (Guangdong Foday Automobile) is a Chinese manufacturer tracing its roots to 1988, specializing in budget pickup trucks and SUVs such as the Explorer and Lion series. It targets commercial and agricultural buyers with low-cost, rugged 4WD vehicles rather than premium positioning. Foday has a limited, low-profile presence in Nepal as an entry-level diesel pickup option, and a clearly documented official Nepal distributor could not be confirmed.

items.name: Ford
items.warranty: 3 years / 60,000-100,000 km (varies by model)
items.serviceNetwork: 4,600 sq ft showroom and 18,000 sq ft workshop at Thapathali, Kathmandu, operated by G.O. Automobiles, appointed by RMA Group (Ford's regional distributor).
items.overview: Ford Motor Company is an American automaker founded in 1903 by Henry Ford, globally known for pioneering the moving assembly line and for popular models such as the Ranger, Everest, and F-Series. In Nepal, Ford vehicles are sold through G.O. Automobiles (part of Golchha Organisation), appointed by RMA Group as the official Ford distributor for the market, with a showroom and service facility in Thapathali, Kathmandu.
strengths: Over a century of automotive heritage

items.name: Foton
items.nepalDealer: MAW Vriddhi Commercial Vehicle Pvt. Ltd.
items.warranty: 3 years (commercial EV models; varies by vehicle type)
items.serviceNetwork: More than 21 after-sales service locations nationwide, including showrooms in Balkumari (Lalitpur) and Butwal, operated by MAW Vriddhi.
items.overview: Foton Motor (Beiqi Foton) is a Chinese commercial-vehicle manufacturer founded in 1996, specializing in trucks, vans, pickups, and increasingly electric commercial vehicles. In Nepal, Foton is distributed by MAW Vriddhi Commercial Vehicle, which focuses on pickups, mini-vans, and ambulances, and has built one of the most extensive after-sales networks among Chinese commercial brands in the country.

items.name: GAC Aion
items.fullName: GAC Aion New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd.
items.warranty: 8 years / 150,000-200,000 km battery and motor (varies by model); 5 years / 120,000 km on non-moving parts
items.serviceNetwork: Showroom at Thapathali, Kathmandu, operated by CG Motors.
items.overview: GAC Aion is the new-energy-vehicle brand of GAC Group (Guangzhou Automobile Group), a major Chinese state-owned automaker, established as a dedicated NEV subsidiary in 2017. It focuses on long-range electric SUVs, including the Aion Y and Aion V. In Nepal, GAC Aion is distributed by CG Motors, with a showroom in Thapathali, Kathmandu.
strengths: Backed by GAC, a major Chinese state automaker

items.name: GWM
items.warranty: 7 years, unlimited km
items.serviceNetwork: Showroom at Thapathali, Kathmandu, with expanding dealer network in Biratnagar, Chitwan, and Butwal, operated by V.G. Impex (Vishal Group).
items.overview: GWM (Great Wall Motor) is a major Chinese automaker founded in 1984 and headquartered in Baoding, known globally for its Haval SUV brand, Ora electric vehicles, and Poer/Wingle pickup trucks. In Nepal, GWM is distributed by V.G. Impex, part of Vishal Group, offering models such as the Haval H6, Haval Jolion, and Ora 03, backed by a 7-year unlimited-kilometer warranty and an expanding dealer network beyond Kathmandu.

items.name: Geely
items.fullName: Zhejiang Geely Holding Group Co., Ltd.
items.warranty: 5 years / 150,000 km (varies by market)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed by LRR Motors from showrooms in Gairidhara and Panipokhari, Kathmandu, with dealer expansion underway to Butwal and Biratnagar.
items.overview: Geely is one of China's largest privately-owned automakers, part of Zhejiang Geely Holding Group, which also owns Volvo Cars, Polestar, and Lotus. Founded in 1986, Geely entered auto manufacturing in 1997 and has since grown into a global group with EV sub-brands such as Geely Galaxy. In Nepal, Geely entered the market through LRR Motors with the Galaxy EX5 electric SUV.
strengths: Backed by large Zhejiang Geely Group

items.name: Haval
items.fullName: Great Wall Motor Company Limited (Haval brand)
items.warranty: 7 years / 200,000 km (varies by market)
items.serviceNetwork: VG Impex Pvt. Ltd. (a Vishal Group company) is the sole authorized GWM/Haval distributor in Nepal, with a showroom in Thapathali, Kathmandu.
items.overview: Haval is the SUV-focused brand of Chinese automaker Great Wall Motor (GWM), one of China's largest SUV and pickup manufacturers. Spun off as a standalone brand in 2013, Haval builds exclusively SUVs, with the H6 ranking among China's best-selling models. In Nepal, GWM/Haval is distributed by VG Impex, offering the Haval H6, Haval Jolion, and GWM Poer pickup.
strengths: Backed by Great Wall Motor scale

items.name: Henrey Volts
items.fullName: Beijing Henrey Automobile Technology Co., Ltd. (Henrey Volts)
items.warranty: Up to 8 years / 150,000 km on battery (model-dependent)
items.serviceNetwork: Sole importer S. Cube Enterprises operates a showroom at Uttardhoka, Lazimpat, Kathmandu.
items.overview: Henrey Volts is a Chinese electric vehicle brand under Beijing Henrey Automobile Technology, focused on affordable small EVs. It entered Nepal in 2022 through sole importer S. Cube Enterprises, launching compact models such as the Model H and HEV300. The brand has a comparatively small footprint in Nepal's fast-growing EV market next to larger Chinese entrants.
strengths: Long battery warranty on select models

items.name: Honda
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km
items.serviceNetwork: 22 service centers nationwide
items.overview: Honda's City has been Nepal's top-selling sedan for over a decade — a testament to the brand's engineering quality and brand trust. Honda SENSING, available from the V trim, brings level 1 ADAS to an accessible price point. Sipradi Trading's service network ensures quick turnarounds even for complex repairs.

items.name: Hyundai
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km
items.serviceNetwork: 25 authorized service centers
items.overview: Hyundai has cemented itself as Nepal's premium Korean brand. From the fuel-efficient Venue to the flagship IONIQ 5 EV, Hyundai covers the full spectrum. Their investment in 800V EV technology puts them years ahead of rivals in the electric segment. With 25 service centers, they have one of the deepest support networks in Nepal.

items.name: IM
items.fullName: IM Motors (Zhiji Automobile Technology Co., Ltd.)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed in Nepal by Paramount Motors, which also represents MG, Mazda, Wuling and Maxus, from its Naxal, Kathmandu facility.
items.overview: IM Motors (Zhiji Motors) is a premium electric vehicle joint venture between SAIC Motor, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech, and Alibaba Group, founded in Shanghai in December 2020. Its name stands for "Intelligence in Motion," reflecting a focus on smart, tech-forward EVs such as the IM L6 and LS6. In Nepal, IM is distributed by Paramount Motors, the same company that represents MG Motor.

items.name: Isuzu
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (varies by market)
items.serviceNetwork: Continental Trading Enterprises Pvt. Ltd. is the sole authorized Isuzu distributor, based in Uttardhoka, Gairidhara, Kathmandu; SML Isuzu commercial vehicles are distributed separately by Laxmi Commercial Vehicles.
items.overview: Isuzu Motors is a Japanese manufacturer best known globally for diesel engines, pickup trucks, and commercial vehicles, with the D-Max pickup and MU-X SUV sold across more than 100 countries. Isuzu has a long history in Nepal's commercial vehicle sector. In the pickup/passenger segment, Isuzu is distributed by Continental Trading Enterprises.
strengths: Strong pickup and commercial vehicle heritage

items.name: JAC Motors
items.fullName: Anhui Jianghuai Automobile Group Co., Ltd. (JAC Motors)
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (base; extended plans available in some markets)
items.serviceNetwork: Shangrila Motors (Golchha Organisation) operates the JAC showroom in Thapathali, Kathmandu, backed by the Golchha Group's 50+ years in Nepal's auto industry.
items.overview: JAC Motors (Anhui Jianghuai Automobile Group) is a major Chinese state-owned automaker founded in 1964, known globally for pickup trucks, light commercial vehicles, and a growing EV range. JAC has been present in Nepal since 2009 and is now distributed by Shangrila Motors, part of the long-established Golchha Organisation, offering models such as the JAC T8 pickup and its electric variant.
strengths: Strong pickup and commercial vehicle range

items.name: JY
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed by LRR Motors from showrooms in Gairidhara and Panipokhari, Kathmandu.
items.overview: JY Air (JuneYao Air) is the automotive brand of JuneYao Group, the Chinese conglomerate behind JuneYao Airlines, which entered the EV business in 2023 through the acquisition of startup Yudo. Its debut model, the JY Air compact electric sedan, launched in Nepal in August 2025 through LRR Motors, the same distributor that represents Geely in the country.

items.name: Jeep
items.warranty: 3 years / 36,000 miles basic; 5 years / 60,000 miles powertrain
items.serviceNetwork: Life Automobile (MAW Group) operates the main Jeep dealership in Basundhara, Kathmandu, with authorized service centers in Pokhara, Biratnagar, Bharatpur, Nepalgunj, Butwal, and Siraha.
items.overview: Jeep is an iconic American SUV and off-road vehicle brand founded in 1941, now owned by the multinational Stellantis group. Known for models like the Wrangler, Compass, and Grand Cherokee, Jeep has built its identity around rugged, go-anywhere capability. In Nepal, Jeep is officially represented by Life Automobile under the MAW Group, offering the Compass, Meridian, and Wrangler with a nationwide service network.

items.name: Jetour
items.overview: Jetour is a travel- and outdoor-focused SUV brand under China's Chery Holding Group, launched in 2018 around its "Travel+" philosophy targeting family and long-distance travel use. Globally, Jetour is known for value-oriented, spacious SUVs like the Dashing and its rugged T-series off-roaders. Jetour entered the Nepali market in 2026 through Laxmi Group, with the Jetour T2 expected to lead its local lineup.

items.name: Kaiyi
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed by Laxmi E-Mobility (LEM), part of Laxmi Group, since 2024.
items.overview: Kaiyi Auto is a Chinese automaker originally founded in 2014 as a subsidiary of Chery Automobile, later renamed Yibin Kaiyi Automobile Co. after relocating to Yibin. The brand focuses on affordable passenger vehicles and SUVs such as the Kaiyi Shiyue. Kaiyi entered Nepal in 2024 through Laxmi E-Mobility, though the brand is still building market recognition locally.
strengths: Backed by Laxmi Group in Nepal

items.name: Kia
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km
items.serviceNetwork: 18 service centers nationwide
items.overview: Kia has been the consistent bestseller in Nepal's compact SUV segment. The Seltos's combination of diesel torque, AWD option, and comprehensive variant lineup has kept it at the top for years. Kia's service quality is rated among the highest in Nepal, with trained technicians and genuine parts available even in Tier-2 cities.

items.name: LS Auto
items.fullName: LS Auto (Longsheng Auto, a Shanghai Launch Automotive Technology subsidiary)
items.overview: LS Auto is a Chinese electric vehicle brand from Longsheng Auto, a subsidiary of Shanghai Launch Automotive Technology, an automotive R&D and manufacturing company that develops vehicles for various OEMs. Its debut model, the LEV 01 electric crossover, was introduced in Nepal in November 2024 through local importer Nexon Venture, making Nepal one of the brand's earliest international markets.
strengths: Backed by Shanghai Launch R&D expertise

items.name: Leapmotor
items.warranty: 4 years / 120,000 km vehicle; 8 years / 160,000 km battery (varies by market)
items.serviceNetwork: Shangrila Motors operates Leapmotor Nepal from Uttardhoka, Kathmandu; the distributor won 'Outstanding Distributor - India & Asia Pacific' at Leapmotor's global dealer meet.
items.overview: Leapmotor is a fast-growing Chinese EV maker founded in 2015 and headquartered in Hangzhou, now backed by a strategic global partnership with Stellantis. The brand is known for developing its own EV technology, including in-house chips and batteries, at competitive prices, with models like the C10, T03, and B10. In Nepal, Leapmotor is distributed by Shangrila Motors (Golchha Organisation), an award-winning regional distributor, and Nepal has served as a launch market for models such as the B10.
strengths: In-house EV chip and battery tech
Competitive pricing for range and features

items.name: Lexus
items.fullName: Lexus (luxury division of Toyota Motor Corporation)
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (varies by market)
items.serviceNetwork: United Traders Syndicate Pvt. Ltd. (Toyota Nepal) is the official distributor of Lexus in Nepal.
items.overview: Lexus is Toyota's luxury vehicle division, established in 1989 and known globally for premium sedans, SUVs, and hybrid technology under the tagline "Experience Amazing." The brand emphasizes reliability, refinement, and craftsmanship, with flagship models like the LX and RX SUVs. Lexus made its official Nepal debut through United Traders Syndicate (Toyota Nepal), offering models such as the LX 450d and RX 350 F Sport.
strengths: Official Nepal debut through Toyota Nepal's distributor

items.name: Lifan
items.overview: Lifan is a Chinese automotive and motorcycle manufacturer founded in Chongqing in 1992, starting as a small motorcycle repair business before growing into one of China's largest private industrial groups. It moved into passenger cars in the early 2000s with models such as the Lifan 520, and its motorcycles have been exported to over 100 countries. The parent group faced serious financial trouble in China, including a 2020 bankruptcy restructuring, and has since shifted focus toward electric vehicles.

items.name: MG
items.tagline: Born in Britain, Loved in Nepal
items.warranty: 3 years / unlimited km
items.serviceNetwork: 12 service centers across Nepal
items.overview: MG Motors has made a remarkable comeback as a modern Chinese brand with British heritage. In Nepal, MG offers feature-rich cars at competitive prices — the Hector packs a 14″ screen and 6 airbags at a mid-range price point that rivals struggle to match. The brand has rapidly expanded its service network and is known for excellent after-sales support.

items.name: Mahindra
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (standard, India)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed and serviced in Nepal through a nationwide dealer and branch network operated by Agni Group.
items.overview: Mahindra & Mahindra is an Indian multinational automaker headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 1945 and part of the broader Mahindra Group. It is one of India's largest SUV and pickup manufacturers, known for models like the Scorpio, Thar, XUV700 and Bolero, and its group is also the world's largest tractor manufacturer by volume. In Nepal, Mahindra vehicles and tractors are distributed by Agni Group.
strengths: India's leading SUV and pickup maker

items.name: Maruti Suzuki
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (standard, India, effective July 2024)
items.serviceNetwork: Distributed in Nepal by CG Motocorp, described by the distributor as having the country's largest sales, service and spare-parts network for a car brand.
items.overview: Maruti Suzuki India Limited is India's largest passenger car manufacturer, formed in 1981 as a government-backed company that entered a landmark joint venture with Japan's Suzuki Motor Corporation in 1982. It became a household name after launching the Maruti 800 in 1983 and today sells models such as the Swift, Baleno, Brezza, Fronx and WagonR. In Nepal it is distributed by CG Motocorp, part of the Chaudhary Group, distinct from the separate distributor that handles Suzuki motorcycles in the country, and is widely reported as the top-selling car brand in the Nepali market.
strengths: Largest car sales/service network in Nepal
Broad affordable hatchback and SUV range

items.name: Maxus
items.overview: Maxus is a commercial and passenger vehicle brand of China's SAIC Motor, established in 2011 after SAIC acquired the intellectual property of Britain's LDV Group. The brand builds vans, pickups and electric SUVs, including the T60/T70 pickups and the MIFA and eTerron electric vehicle ranges. In Nepal, Maxus vehicles are imported and distributed by Himalaya Motrox, part of the Himalaya Organization, with a growing focus on electric models such as the eTerron 9.
strengths: Backing of SAIC Motor, a major global automaker

items.name: Mazda
items.warranty: 3 years / 36,000 miles (New Vehicle Limited Warranty; 5 years / 60,000 miles powertrain)
items.serviceNetwork: Mazda showroom and service facility located in Naxal, Kathmandu, operated by Paramount Motors.
items.overview: Mazda Motor Corporation is a Japanese automaker headquartered in Hiroshima, founded in 1920 and known for its rotary-engine heritage (the Cosmo Sport) and later for its "Zoom-Zoom" driving-focused brand identity introduced in 2002. It produces cars such as the Mazda2, Mazda3, CX-5 and MX-5 Miata, recognized for their Kodo design language and Skyactiv engineering. Mazda vehicles are distributed in Nepal by Paramount Motors Pvt. Ltd.

items.name: Mercedes-Benz
items.warranty: 2 years, unlimited mileage (international standard; regional variations apply)
items.overview: Mercedes-Benz is a German luxury automaker tracing its roots to Karl Benz's 1886 patent motor car, formally created through the 1926 merger of Daimler and Benz. Long positioned as a premium, engineering-led brand under the motto "Das Beste oder Nichts" ("The Best or Nothing"), it produces sedans, SUVs and performance cars across its A- to S-Class and AMG/EQ lineups. In Nepal, Mercedes-Benz vehicles have reportedly been imported since the 1960s, currently through Deepak Gautam & Company.
strengths: Broad sedan, SUV and AMG lineup

items.name: Mitsubishi
items.warranty: 5 years / 100,000 km (standard New Car Warranty, international markets; varies by region)
items.serviceNetwork: Leon Motors operates showrooms and service centers in Kathmandu (including Sinamangal/Shantinagar) and Pokhara.
items.overview: Mitsubishi Motors Corporation is a Japanese automaker with roots in Mitsubishi's 1917 Model-A, formally established as an independent company in 1970 after separating from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. It is known for rugged and off-road-capable vehicles such as the Pajero Sport, Outlander and L200/Triton pickup, and was an early mover in plug-in hybrid technology. In Nepal, Mitsubishi is distributed by Leon Motors Pvt. Ltd.
strengths: Rugged Pajero Sport and Outlander SUVs

items.name: Neta
items.fullName: Zhejiang Hozon New Energy Automobile Co., Ltd. (NETA Auto)
items.overview: Neta (stylized NETA) is a Chinese electric vehicle brand launched in 2018 by Hozon New Energy Automobile, a company founded in 2014 in Zhejiang province by a team including former Chery engineers. It targets budget-conscious and urban EV buyers with models such as the Neta V and Neta X. In Nepal, Neta EVs are distributed by CG Motors, a subsidiary of the Chaudhary Group.
strengths: Backed by Hozon New Energy R&D
Entered Nepal EV market via CG Motors

items.name: Nissan
items.warranty: 3 years / 36,000 miles (basic); 5 years / 60,000 miles (powertrain) — international standard, varies by region
items.overview: Nissan Motor Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese automaker founded in 1933 in Yokohama, known globally for models such as the Leaf, Qashqai/X-Trail, Magnite and Kicks, and for its long-running alliance with Renault and Mitsubishi. Its global brand philosophy is captured in the tagline "Innovation that Excites," adopted in 2012. In Nepal, Nissan vehicles are distributed by Pioneer Moto Corp Pvt. Ltd.

items.name: Omoda
items.overview: Omoda is an export-focused SUV brand launched in 2022 by China's Chery Automobile (founded 1997), aimed at younger buyers with fashion-forward crossover styling. Alongside sister brand Jaecoo, it is sold only outside mainland China as part of Chery's international expansion strategy, with models such as the Omoda 5/E5. In Nepal, Omoda entered the market in 2024 through SPG Automobiles, the authorized distributor for Chery's Omoda and Jaecoo brands.
strengths: Backed by Chery's global export strategy

items.name: Proton
items.fullName: Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Sdn Bhd (PROTON Holdings Berhad)
items.warranty: 5 years / 150,000 km (standard, Malaysia)
items.serviceNetwork: Jagdamba Motors operates an expanding network of showrooms and service centers across Nepal, including Kathmandu, Pokhara, Birgunj, Janakpur, Nepalgunj and Bhaktapur.
items.overview: Proton (Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional) is Malaysia's national car manufacturer, founded in 1983 under a government initiative championed by then-Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad. Its first model, the Proton Saga launched in 1985, made it a symbol of Malaysian industrialization, and the company later formed a technology partnership with China's Geely, which now holds a stake in Proton. In Nepal, Proton is distributed by Jagdamba Motors, which has recently expanded its showroom network and introduced Proton's e.MAS electric SUV range to the country.

items.name: Renault
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (India-market standard; terms vary by region)
items.overview: Renault is a French automaker founded in 1899 by Louis Renault and his brothers, today part of Renault Group and its long-standing alliance with Nissan and Mitsubishi. Known for models such as the Clio, Duster, Kwid and Triber, its current global brand tagline is "Passion for Life," adopted in 2015. In Nepal, Renault vehicles are distributed by Advanced Automobiles Pvt. Ltd., with a showroom at Naxal, Kathmandu.

items.name: Riddara
items.fullName: Radar New Energy Vehicle (Zhejiang) Co., Ltd. (RIDDARA)
items.serviceNetwork: CG Motors has cited over 20 authorized service centers and access to more than 260 EV charging stations nationwide supporting its EV brands, including Riddara.
items.overview: Riddara (also marketed as Radar or Geely Radar) is a Chinese electric pickup truck brand established in 2022 under Zhejiang Geely Holding Group, focused on the outdoor and adventure EV segment. It has been described as China's top-selling new-energy pickup brand and has expanded to nearly 20 overseas markets. In Nepal, Riddara's RD6 electric pickup is distributed by CG Motors, part of the Chaudhary Group, and was marketed as Nepal's first fully electric pickup platform.

items.name: SERES
items.serviceNetwork: Showrooms in Naxal (flagship), Panipokhari and Lalitpur inside Kathmandu Valley, plus Pokhara and Butwal outside the valley.
items.overview: SERES is a Chinese electric vehicle brand under Seres Group (formerly Sokon), which pivoted from a decades-old auto parts and microvan manufacturer into new-energy vehicles starting in 2016. The brand is best known internationally for its range-extended and pure-electric SUVs, including its joint AITO line with Huawei. In Nepal, SERES is distributed by MAW Vriddhi Autocorp, offering the compact Seres Mini EV and the Seres 3 electric SUV.

items.name: SWM
items.overview: SWM is an Italian marque originally founded near Milan in 1971 as an off-road motorcycle manufacturer, before going dormant in the 1980s. Chinese conglomerate Shineray Group acquired the brand in 2014 and relaunched it in 2016 with a range of SUVs alongside its revived motorcycle lineup, blending Italian design with Chinese manufacturing. In Nepal, Gyan Earthmovers is the authorized distributor, though its presence has centered on SWM's motorcycle range.

items.name: Skoda
items.warranty: 2 years / unlimited km (varies by model, some campaigns extend to 4 years / 100,000 km)
items.serviceNetwork: Main showroom at Teku, Kathmandu, with authorized dealer partners including Roadwayz Lifestyle in Butwal and Varunaditya Enterprises in Nepalgunj.
items.overview: Škoda is one of the world's oldest car manufacturers, founded in 1895 in Mladá Boleslav, Czech Republic, and has been part of the Volkswagen Group since 1991. Known for practical, feature-rich vehicles under its 'Simply Clever' philosophy, Škoda offers sedans and SUVs including the Rapid, Superb, and Kodiaq. MAW Enterprises has been the authorized importer of Škoda in Nepal since 2008.

items.name: Skywell
items.serviceNetwork: Flagship showroom in Narayanchaur, Naxal, Kathmandu, plus a showroom in Radhe Radhe, Bhaktapur.
items.overview: Skywell is a Chinese electric vehicle brand under Jiangsu Skywell Automobile, established by Skyworth founder Huang Hongsheng as the company's new-energy vehicle arm. It debuted its first model, the ET5 SUV, in 2020, and has since added the BE11 electric SUV. In Nepal, Skywell recently changed distributors, with LRR Motors taking over from G Motors after the manufacturer sought stronger sales and after-sales performance.

items.name: SsangYong
items.fullName: SsangYong Motor Company (now part of KG Mobility)
items.serviceNetwork: Showroom at Uttardhoka, Kathmandu, plus a Pokhara showroom at Uttam Chowk; authorized service centers at Auto Home Pvt. Ltd. (UN Park, Lalitpur) and Auto Village Pvt. Ltd. (Ratopul, Kathmandu).
items.overview: SsangYong is a South Korean automaker founded in 1954, historically known for rugged SUVs and off-roaders such as the Rexton, Korando, and Tivoli. The company was acquired by South Korea's KG Group in 2022 and rebranded as KG Mobility (KGM) in 2023, though the SsangYong name remains widely used in existing markets. IMS Motors has been the authorized distributor for SsangYong in Nepal since 2016.

items.name: Subaru
items.serviceNetwork: Showroom at Naxal, Kathmandu, with dedicated after-sales service lines.
items.overview: Subaru is a Japanese automaker known globally for its Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive system and Boxer engines, offering models such as the Forester, Outback, and XV/Crosstrek. Vijay Motors Pvt. Ltd., established in 1998, has been the sole authorized distributor of Subaru in Nepal since 2005. The Nepal lineup currently centers on the XV, Forester, and Outback SUVs.

items.name: Suzuki
items.warranty: 2 years / 40,000 km
items.serviceNetwork: 35+ service points including rural Nepal
items.overview: Suzuki is the champion of affordable, reliable motoring in Nepal. The Swift is Nepal's best-selling hatchback, prized for its 24.8 km/l efficiency, peppy city character, and the lowest maintenance costs in the segment. Suzuki's network of 35+ service points reaches rural Nepal better than any other brand.

items.name: Tata
items.serviceNetwork: Multiple showrooms and service centers nationwide via Sipradi Trading and regional dealer partners, including SH Motors (Chitwan), Gandaki Trade House (Pokhara), and G.A.R.S. Trading Concern (Dhangadhi).
items.overview: Tata Motors is India's largest automaker, founded in 1945 and part of the Tata Group, producing passenger cars, commercial vehicles, and electric vehicles sold across global markets. It is known for value-focused SUVs and hatchbacks like the Nexon, Punch, and Harrier, as well as a large commercial vehicle range. Sipradi Trading Pvt. Ltd. is the sole authorized distributor of Tata vehicles in Nepal, operating one of the country's widest automotive dealer networks.

items.name: Tesla
items.warranty: 4 years / 50,000 miles basic vehicle warranty; 8 years / up to 150,000 miles battery and drive unit warranty (varies by model)
items.overview: Tesla is a US electric vehicle and clean energy company known for models including the Model 3, Model Y, Model S, and Model X. For years Tesla vehicles reached Nepal only through individual grey-market importers, since Tesla itself does not recognize such sales and offered no local support. Tesla Nepal Pvt. Ltd. has since signed an agreement with Tesla Inc. to become an official distributor, aiming to bring factory pricing and authorized after-sales service to the country.
strengths: Long EV range and Supercharging tech

items.name: Toyota
items.warranty: 3 years / 100,000 km (Hybrid battery 8 yr)
items.serviceNetwork: 30+ authorized service points
items.overview: Toyota is Nepal's most trusted automotive brand — a reputation built on decades of reliability in tough Himalayan terrain. The Prius's 26 km/l efficiency is unmatched in Nepal, and Toyota hybrid batteries carry an 8-year warranty for peace of mind. With over 30 service points including in remote districts, Toyota ownership is worry-free across Nepal.

items.name: Volkswagen
items.warranty: 2 years / unlimited km, plus 3-year paint warranty
items.serviceNetwork: More than 10 showrooms and nine service centers nationwide, including a flagship showroom at Naxal and main showroom at Balaju, Kathmandu.
items.overview: Volkswagen is one of the world's largest automakers, founded in Germany in 1937 and known for models like the Polo, Golf, and Tiguan/Taigun. The brand has shifted its global messaging over the years, from the long-running 'Das Auto' slogan to its current 'Drive Bigger' platform emphasizing electrification. Pooja International Nepal has handled Volkswagen sales and distribution in the country for over a decade, operating one of the larger dealer networks among European brands in Nepal.
strengths: Established Nepal network since over a decade
Wide model range from hatchback to SUV

items.name: Volvo
items.overview: Volvo Cars is a Swedish automaker founded in 1927, globally recognized for its focus on automotive safety innovation and Scandinavian design, offering SUVs and sedans such as the XC40, XC60, XC90, and S90. Volvo has been majority-owned by China's Geely Holding Group since 2010. Passenger Volvo cars are sold in Nepal, though this research could not confirm a single current officially designated passenger-car distributor separate from Volvo's construction equipment distributor.

items.name: Wuling
items.serviceNetwork: Showroom at Naxal, Kathmandu (near the Hyundai showroom).
items.overview: Wuling is a Chinese vehicle brand produced by SAIC-GM-Wuling, a joint venture between SAIC Motor, General Motors, and Guangxi Automobile Group formed in 2002. Long known for affordable microvans in China, Wuling has expanded into budget electric vehicles such as the Air EV, Mini EV, and Binguo hatchback. In Nepal, Wuling's EV lineup is distributed by Paramount Motors, which has been expanding the brand's local showroom presence and model range.
strengths: Backed by SAIC and GM joint venture

items.name: Xpeng
items.fullName: Guangzhou XPeng Motors Technology Co., Ltd.
items.warranty: 8 years / 160,000 km battery and motor warranty; 5 years / 120,000 km warranty on other components
items.serviceNetwork: Flagship showroom at Thapathali, Kathmandu, plus a showroom in Chitwan; distributed through 20+ sales and service outlets nationwide with an associated DC fast-charging network.
items.overview: XPeng is a Chinese smart EV manufacturer founded in 2014 and known for its focus on autonomous driving technology and software-defined vehicles, with models like the G6, G9, and P7. CG Motors introduced XPeng to Nepal in November 2024 with a flagship showroom at Thapathali, launching the G6 electric SUV. The brand has continued to expand its Nepal footprint with showrooms in cities including Pokhara and Chitwan.

items.name: Zeekr
items.serviceNetwork: Main showroom at Thapathali, Kathmandu.
items.overview: Zeekr is Geely Holding Group's premium electric vehicle brand, launched in 2021 to compete in the global luxury EV segment, with its design center in Gothenburg, Sweden. The brand emphasizes high-performance EV platforms and premium technology, exemplified by the Zeekr X compact SUV. Pioneer Moto Corp became the authorized distributor for Zeekr in Nepal in 2024, currently offering the Zeekr X as the brand's sole model in the local market.
